Manage your Voidhash projects from the terminal. On a terminal, 'voidhash' alone opens a screen that
sets your app up and shows its project; 'voidhash status' prints the same in a few lines.

Environment, for CI and scripts:
  VOIDHASH_API_KEY  A project secret key or a person's token; used instead of the stored sign-in
  VOIDHASH_API_URL  The API server, instead of the configured api_url
  VOIDHASH_PROFILE  The config profile, when --profile is not passed
  NO_COLOR          Print without colors

Usage:
  voidhash <command> [flags]

Get started:
  init                     Set this directory up for a Voidhash project.
  integrate, wizard        Add Voidhash to this app, with a coding agent wiring it into your code.
  login                    Sign in by approving a code in your browser.
  logout                   Sign out on this computer.
  whoami                   Show who the CLI is signed in as, and what it can use.

Choose a project:
  status                   Show the project commands act on here, and what its setup still needs.
  link                     Make a project this directory's: commands run here and below act on it.
  unlink                   Remove the link 'voidhash link' made for this directory.
  switch                   Choose your default project, which commands act on outside linked
                           directories.
  open                     Open a page of the project's dashboard in your browser.

Persons and access:
  person, persons          The people using your app: find them, see their access, edit and erase
                           them.

Catalog:
  product, products        The products people buy, and the perks they grant.
  perk, perks              The perks your app checks for, which products grant.

Payments:
  provider, providers      Where the project takes payments: stores and payment sources.

Paywalls:
  paywall, paywalls        Paywalls and onboarding flows: create, build, deploy, archive and delete
                           them.
  location, locations      The places in your apps that show a paywall, and what each shows.

Flags and experiments:
  flag, flags              Feature flags: roll features out, fix them for testers, and see who gets
                           what.
  experiment, experiments  A/B tests: set up arms, start, follow the results, and conclude.

Analytics and ads:
  events, event            The events your apps send: list, watch and choose which are stored.
  insights, insight        Revenue, subscription, trial and churn metrics.
  analytics                Acquisition, cohorts, tracking health, charts and alerts.
  ads, ad                  Paid acquisition: ad accounts, campaigns, reports and what needs
                           attention.

Your backend:
  webhook, webhooks        The backend URLs your project's events are sent to.

Messaging:
  push                     Push notifications to your users' devices: send one, see how it went, set
                           up push services.

Team and settings:
  org, orgs                The organizations that own your projects: list, create, rename and delete
                           them.
  project, projects        Your projects: list, create, rename and delete them.
  member, members          Your organization's team: list members, add people, change roles, remove
                           people.
  settings                 The project's settings, explained: view them and change one.
  domain, domains          Tracking domains: serve the web SDK from your own subdomain.
  sandbox                  Test your app's purchases without a store.
  key, keys                See the project's API keys.
  audit                    Show who changed what in the project, newest first.
  notices, notice          Notices your organizations sent you: list them, mark them read, archive
                           them, choose how they reach you.
  feedback                 Send feedback to the Voidhash team.

Paywall components:
  dev                      Build the project's components on every change and serve them to your
                           paywall editor.
  new                      Add a component with its editor panel to the working copy in
                           .voidhash/components/.
  publish                  Publish the new and modified components of .voidhash/ as new catalog
                           versions.
  test                     Check a component module against the conformance suite and its editor
                           panel against the panel checks.
  registry                 Publish components to your organization's registry, and install them.

More:
  types                    Generate and check the type files of the project's slugs.
  mcp                      Connect AI agents to Voidhash over MCP.
  api                      Find, describe and call any operation of the Voidhash API.
  auth                     Sign the CLI in and out, and see who it is signed in as.
  config                   Show the CLI settings: API and dashboard URLs, credential, default
                           project and links.
  help                     Help about any command
  completion               Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell

Flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
  -h, --help               Show help for a command
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)
  -v, --version            Show the CLI's version

Examples:
  voidhash login
  voidhash link acme/app
  voidhash product list --json

Run 'voidhash <command> --help' for more about a command.
